genius.notes: Anchorage Digital Bank, N.A. is the OCC-chartered national trust bank issuing USDPT for Western Union. Anchorage now publishes USDPT reserve holdings monthly and links Deloitte's May 2026 examination. ADB explicitly states it expects to become a PPSI once the GENIUS Act becomes effective (Jan 18, 2027 at the latest). The issuerPathway is federal-qualified-nonbank because ADB holds an OCC national trust charter but is uninsured (no FDIC insurance required), placing it outside the IDI-subsidiary category and instead on the federal nonbank/OCC pathway. A 2022 OCC consent order for BSA/AML deficiencies was fully terminated by the OCC in August 2025; no active enforcement action exists as of the review date. No PPSI approval or application has been filed; the PPSI application framework remains in proposed rulemaking.
